data.long_meaning: From the Greek name ITHYMOS (ITHYMOS), meaning 'dedicated to God'. In the New Testament, Ithamar (ITH'-a-mar) is the name of a priestly descendant of Aaron. The name Ithaman carries the meaning “Dedicated to God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ithaman usually hope their child will grow to embody dedicated to god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are deeply devoted to God.
data.etymology: Ithaman belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dedicated to God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ithaman total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
